les: Nie elke handel is regverdig nie

items.bewering: Twee maats ruil 'n appel vir 'n pakkie druiwe. Albei stem uit eie keuse in, en albei weet wat hulle kry. Regverdige handel tussen 'n boer en 'n groot koper vra dieselfde van albei kante.
items.bron: Mapping checked against WFTO's fair trade principles (fair price 'mutually agreed by all through dialogue and participation'; Principle 2 transparency in commercial relations), via wfto-europe.org/the-10-principles-of-fair-trade-2 and expe.ritimo.org/Fair-trade. The swap between friends carries only the free-and-informed-consent half of fairness, and the very next sentence adds the price condition with 'ook', so a learner is not left thinking that consent alone makes trade fair. The mapping holds.

items.bewering: Die prys moet ook dek wat dit die maker werklik gekos het om die goed te maak. Dit moet die maker genoeg gee om behoorlik te lewe.
items.bron: Fairtrade International: the Fairtrade Minimum Price aims to cover the average cost of sustainable production (fairtrade.net/standard/minimum-price-info). Fairtrade states its goal of a living income (fairtrade.net/en/why-fairtrade/why-we-do-it/decent-livelihoods/living-income.html), and WFTO Principle 4 requires 'socially acceptable' fair pay (wfto-europe.org/the-10-principles-of-fair-trade-2).

items.bewering: Onregverdige handel lyk van buite na dieselfde soort ruil. Maar die een kant het baie minder keuse of baie minder inligting as die ander. Daardie kant kry ook minder terug as wat sy werk werd is.
items.bron: A conceptual definition consistent with the literature on smallholders' weak bargaining position, where farm-gate prices come out of 'asymmetric negotiations' with fewer buyers and less price information (case studies on IFPRI South Asia, southasia.ifpri.info/files/2025/12/3.-Rakib-Hossain.pdf; ICTD 2019, ictd.cs.washington.edu/docs/papers/2019/ziegler_ictd2019.pdf), and with UNCTAD on the 'weak position of dispersed, smallholding farmers' (unctad.org/node/7612).

items.bewering: Die mense wat die goed maak, is dikwels baie, en elkeen van hulle is klein. Die kopers is gewoonlik min, en elkeen van hulle is groot.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Fairtrade Risk Map, cocoa: 5-6 million smallholder households produce 90% of the world's cocoa, and nine traders and processors handle 75% of the trade, an 'hourglass' chain (riskmap.fairtrade.net/commodities/cocoa). The Cocoa Barometer 2015 (oxfamnovib.nl) and UNCTAD (unctad.org/node/7612) describe the same concentration. 'dikwels' and 'gewoonlik' are suitably hedged.

items.bewering: Baie oeste hou net 'n paar dae, en 'n klein boer het selde 'n koel stoorplek.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Smallholder marketing studies name 'the perishable nature of their product' and 'lack of adequate storage' as causes of weak bargaining power (agrifoodscience.com/index.php/TURJAF/article/download/3886/2107/33971; southasia.ifpri.info/files/2025/12/3.-Rakib-Hossain.pdf). 'Baie oeste' rightly does not claim all crops, since cocoa and grain store well.

items.bewering: Dikwels kom min kopers by die plaas verby.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Studies of farm-gate sales find that selling at the farm 'may entail a more limited choice of buyers' (catalog.lib.kyushu-u.ac.jp/opac_download_md/1543425/p535.pdf). A Mozambique report on farmer bargaining power says the same (cddmoz.org).

items.bewering: Die boer weet meestal nie wat sy goed in 'n verre winkel kos nie.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Farmers in Ghana, Tanzania and Zimbabwe 'often do not have timely access to salient and accurate information on prices', and intermediaries control market information (ictd.cs.washington.edu/docs/papers/2019/ziegler_ictd2019.pdf; DFID research output on horticultural information flows to smallholders, gov.uk). The claim is about the retail price in a distant shop, which is even further from the farmer than the market prices those studies discuss, so 'meestal' is supportable.

items.bewering: Al daardie dinge maak dit swaar om 'n lae aanbod te weier. Vir die koper is dieselfde lae prys 'n goeie koop.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Follows from the bargaining-power sources above: farmers 'depend on immediate cash after harvest', and perishability and missing storage 'compound their weak bargaining position' (agrifoodscience.com TURJAF article; southasia.ifpri.info). The second sentence is true by definition.

items.bewering: Regverdig beteken nie dat albei kante ewe veel kry nie. Dit beteken dat niemand gedwing of mislei is nie en dat die werk genoeg betaal word.
items.bron: WFTO defines a fair price as 'mutually agreed by all through dialogue and participation' that 'provides fair pay to the producers', with no requirement of equal shares (expe.ritimo.org/Fair-trade; wfto-europe.org/the-10-principles-of-fair-trade-2). It matches the lesson's own first block.

items.bewering: Onregverdige handel is 'n egte deel van handel. ... Tog is nie alle handel onregverdig nie.
items.bron: Supported by the cocoa living-income evidence below, and by the fact that certified fair trade schemes exist only because conventional terms often fall short (fairtrade.net living-income page). Saying 'not all trade is unfair' is the measured form and needs no superlative check.

items.bewering: Baie boere wat kakao kweek, verdien nie genoeg om behoorlik te lewe nie.
items.bron: Van Vliet, Slingerland, Waarts and Giller (2021), 'A Living Income for Cocoa Producers in Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana?', Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems 5:732831 (frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fsufs.2021.732831/full; research.wur.nl). Across six datasets, 73-90% of cocoa households fall short of a living income. 'Baie' understates rather than overstates this.

items.bewering: Op party produkte staan 'n keurmerk vir regverdige handel. Dit wys dat iemand die handel agter die produk nagegaan het.
items.bron: Fairtrade International: independent certifiers audit producers, traders and companies for compliance with the standards, including Minimum Price and Premium payments (fairtrade.net/about/certification; fairtrade.net/en/why-fairtrade/how-we-do-it/how-does-the-label-work/how-fairtrade-certification-works.html).

items.bewering: Die reëls van so 'n merk kom van een organisasie. Aparte keurders besoek die plase en ken die merk toe as die reëls nagekom word.
items.bron: Fairtrade International sets the standards. FLOCERT, an ISO 17065-accredited certifier, 'is responsible for the certification of all producers': on-site audits of producer organisations before they may sell Fairtrade products, three-year cycles and unannounced audits (fairtrade.net/about/certification; flocert.net FAQ). Strictly, the auditors certify the producer and the right to put the mark on a retail pack is licensed separately, but 'ken die merk toe' is a fair Grade 6 compression and does not mislead. Each other fair trade label (for example WFTO, Fair Trade USA) also has its rules from one body, so the general 'so 'n merk' holds.

items.bewering: Vir die meeste produkte: 'n laagste prys wat die koper moet betaal, ook wanneer pryse val.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade International: the Fairtrade Minimum Price applies to most Fairtrade certified products, acts as a safety net when market prices fall, and the buyer pays the market price when it is higher (fairtrade.net/standard/minimum-price-info; fairtrade.net/en/why-fairtrade/how-we-do-it/standards/fairtrade-minimum-price-and-premium-information.html). There are exceptions, for example herbs and spices with no fixed minimum, so 'vir die meeste produkte' is the correct quantifier and 'laagste prys' correctly renders a minimum price.

items.bewering: Ekstra geld bo-op die prys vir die groep boere.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade Premium: 'an extra sum of money, paid on top of the selling price', which goes to the producer organisation, whose members decide together how to use it (fairtrade.net/standard?&L=1; fairtrade.net/standard/spo). Note: on hired-labour plantations the Premium goes to the workers' body rather than to a farmers' group. The lesson's frame is farmer groups throughout, so this is incomplete, not false.

items.bewering: Geen gedwonge werk en geen kinderarbeid nie.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade: 'Forced labour and child labour are prohibited under the Fairtrade Standards'. Under-15s may not be employed and under-18s may not do work that harms their schooling or development, while family farm help is allowed under strict conditions (fairtrade.ca/?p=11866; fairtrade.net/standard/about). That matches the lesson's own definition of kinderarbeid, so 'geen kinderarbeid' is accurate.

items.bewering: Reëls wat die grond en die water om die plaas beskerm.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade environmental criteria cover 'responsible water and waste management, preserving biodiversity and soil fertility', and the Hired Labour standard has a dedicated 'Soil and Water' section, 4.3 (fairtrade.net/standard/about; files.fairtrade.net/standards/2014-01-15_HL_EN_v1.11.pdf).

items.bewering: Die organisasie agter die merk sê self dat die merk nie 'n behoorlike inkomste waarborg nie.
items.blok: Wat die merk nie belowe nie
items.bron: Fairtrade International, living income page: 'Fairtrade certification alone doesn't guarantee that farmers will earn a living income – it depends on multiple factors' (fairtrade.net/en/why-fairtrade/why-we-do-it/decent-livelihoods/living-income.html). The attribution to the organisation itself is accurate.

items.bewering: 'n Groep boere verkoop net soveel onder die merk as wat kopers bestel. By party oeste is dit net 'n klein deel van die oes. Die res gaan teen gewone pryse weg.
items.blok: Wat die merk nie belowe nie
items.bron: Fairtrade's own figures: about 4% of Fairtrade-certified tea was sold on Fairtrade terms in 2023, and around 7% in 2020 (fairtradecampaigns.org/?p=55297; Fairtrade UK 'Brew it Fair' fact sheet, fairtrade.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Brew-it-Fair-fact-sheet-What-do-you-know-about-tea.pdf). West African cocoa organisations sold an average of 36% on Fairtrade terms in 2012-13 (fairtrade.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Fairtrade-cocoa-West-Africa-report-2014.pdf), and the remainder is sold conventionally. 'By party oeste ... 'n klein deel' is correct, with tea as the clear case.

items.bewering: regverdige handel: Handel waar albei kante self instem, weet wat hulle kry, en die maker behoorlik betaal word.
items.bron: Consistent with WFTO's fair price principle (mutual agreement, transparency, fair pay; wfto-europe.org/the-10-principles-of-fair-trade-2; expe.ritimo.org/Fair-trade) and with the Fairtrade Minimum Price's purpose (fairtrade.net/standard/minimum-price-info). It is true read on its own.

items.bewering: onregverdige handel: Handel waar die een kant min keuse of inligting het en te min kry.
items.bron: This is the mirror of the fair trade definition above and is consistent with the bargaining-power sources (ictd.cs.washington.edu ziegler_ictd2019; unctad.org/node/7612). It matches the study block 'Wanneer handel onregverdig is'.

items.bewering: keurmerk: 'n Merk op 'n produk wat wys dat iemand dit nagegaan het.
items.bron: Dutch government consumer guidance: a keurmerk is a mark on a product showing that it 'aan bepaalde kwaliteitseisen voldoet' (rijksoverheid.nl, 'Hoe weet ik of een keurmerk betrouwbaar is'). The DBNL Algemeen letterkundig lexicon glosses it as a quality guarantee. The entry is true but thin: it says the product was checked, not that it passed. The study block supplies the 'passed' half ('ken die merk toe as die reëls nagekom word'). A writer may want to add 'en goedgekeur' so the entry also stands alone, but this is not an error.

items.bewering: organisasie: 'n Groep mense wat saam aan een doel werk.
items.bron: Cambridge Dictionary: 'a group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose'. Oxford: 'an organized group of people with a particular purpose' (both quoted in search results; dictionary.cambridge.org blocked direct fetch).

items.bewering: gedwonge werk: Werk wat iemand moet doen sonder dat hy kan weier.
items.bron: ILO Forced Labour Convention No. 29 (1930), Article 2(1): 'all work or service which is exacted from any person under the menace of any penalty and for which the said person has not offered himself voluntarily' (cited in the International Cocoa Initiative glossary 2022, cocoainitiative.org; dol.gov ILAB). The entry captures the core of 'not voluntary and cannot refuse'.

items.bewering: kinderarbeid: Werk deur kinders wat hulle skade doen, wat hulle uit die skool hou, of waarvoor hulle nog te jonk is.
items.bron: ILO, from Conventions 138 and 182: work that 'is harmful to their physical or mental development', that 'interferes with their education, for example by keeping children out of school', and that depends on 'the age of a child, and the nature of work' (International Cocoa Initiative glossary 2022, cocoainitiative.org; OECD-FAO cocoa due diligence handbook, oecd.org). All three limbs map correctly.

opsomming: Every checkable claim in the lesson is supported. That includes the Fairtrade minimum price applying to 'most' products, the Premium, the labour and environmental rules, Fairtrade's own statement that certification does not guarantee a living income, the small share of some crops sold on Fairtrade terms, and the cocoa living-income gap. Only one optional tightening: the 'keurmerk' glossary entry says a product was checked but not that it passed, which the study text supplies.
